Choose the most appropriate word to fill in the blank given in the passage. Read the following passage and answer the given questions. When the rest of the world was shutting down, a small tribal community tucked into the forested hills of central India was quietly doing the opposite. The group, known locally as the Minis, had long maintained an intimate relationship with the land around them, drawing sustenance and identity from forests that outsiders rarely visited and development planners rarely considered. The seeds of what would become a remarkable community effort were planted in 2019, when Pavitra, a young tribal resident with a quiet but determined vision, began to form the foundation of an agroforestry initiative on communal land. Pavitra believed that integrating food crops with tree cultivation could generate stable, year-round income for families who had historically depended on uncertain forest produce and seasonal labour in distant cities. Progress was slow initially, with only a handful of households willing to participate in what many elders viewed with cautious skepticism. Then the lockdown arrived. Migrant workers who had left the village years earlier to form part of the urban labour force returned home suddenly and without income. For weeks, these families began to feel the pinch of unemployment, depleted savings, and an uncertain future. Rather than remaining idle, many turned to Pavitra's agroforestry plots, lending their labour and, gradually, their commitment. ______________, what followed surprised even the most optimistic among them. With a larger collective workforce tending the land, harvesting expanded significantly. The Minis conducted a substantial harvest during the lockdown period that not only ensured food security for participating households but generated surplus produce sold to nearby markets. Families that had previously earned single incomes reported that their household earnings had effectively doubled within one growing season. The Minis had discovered something that no government scheme had managed to deliver — that when crisis drives a community back to its roots, the land, tended with collective care, rarely disappoints.
